title: Software Engineer, Platform - Munich, Germany
description:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.  

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

The responsibilities of our Platform team include building and maintaining all backend services, including, but not limited to, payments, analytics, subscriptions, new products, text to speech, and external APIs.

This is a key role and ideal for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys fast-paced environments, is passionate about making product decisions, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount. 

Our interview process involves several technical interviews and we aim to complete them within 1 week. 

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust APIs including public TTS API, internal APIs like Payment, Subscription, Auth and Consumption Tracking, ensuring they meet business and scalability requirements
  • Oversee the full backend API landscape, enhancing and optimizing for performance and maintainability
  • Collaborate on B2B solutions, focusing on customization and integration needs for enterprise clients
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to align backend architecture with overall product strategy and user experience

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • Proven experience in backend development: TS/Node (required)
  • Direct experience with GCP and knowledge of AWS, Azure, or other cloud providers
  • Efficiency in ideation and implementation, prioritizing tasks based on urgency and impact
  • Preferred: Experience with Docker

  • Transport & Logistik – Systeme mit hohem Datendurchsatz und Echtzeit-Anforderungen
  • Großkonzerne wie Deutsche Bahn / DB Systel (eisenbahnspezifische Domänen: Fahrplanmanagement, Vertrieb, Leit- und Sicherungstechnik)

  • Enterprise- und Mittelstands-Kunden aus verschiedensten Branchen

Erfahrung in einem dieser Umfelder ist ein starkes Plus – sag uns in den Fragen, wo du herkommst.

Senior-Level. Unsere Kunden brauchen Leute, die ab Tag eins liefern und eigenständig arbeiten.

  • WebSockets für Echtzeit-Funktionen
  • REST- und API-Design
  • Tests gehören bei uns zur Definition of Done, nicht in die Nacharbeit
  • CI/CD, Git, Docker, agiles Arbeiten

Frontend (das erwarten wir):

  • Angular mit TypeScript

Von Vorteil (kein Muss):

  • Erfahrung mit modernen Web-Architekturen und dem Zuschnitt von Services
  • Barrierefreiheit (BITV 2.0 / WCAG AA), DevSecOps / Security by Design

title: Full Stack Product Engineer (m/w/d) – Bling Schule
description:
Deine Mission

Wir bauen den ersten Payment-Dienstleister, mit dem Schulen und Kitas in Deutschland wirklich alles bargeldlos abwickeln können und suchen Verstärkung. Als Product Engineer im Bling Schule Team übernimmst du von Tag eins an echte Ownership: viel Freiheit, kurze Wege und die Chance, ein Produkt von Grund auf mitzugestalten und unsere bestehenden Systeme weiterzuentwickeln. Du shippst Features end-to-end, bist also von der ersten Idee über die Entwicklung bis zum Launch verantwortlich. Dabei triffst du gemeinsam mit unserem CTO und unserem Lead Developer die technischen Entscheidungen, die zählen und ihr funktioniert dabei wie ein eigenes kleines Startup im Startup. Am Ende trägt deine Arbeit direkt dazu bei, dass Bling Schule zu der robusten, sicheren und skalierbaren Plattform wird, auf der Zahlungen für tausende Familien und Schulen reibungslos laufen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem CTO und unserem Lead Developer Bling Schule weiter, von ersten Ideen über die technische Konzeption bis zum Go-live neuer Features.
  • Du gestaltest und optimierst die technische Infrastruktur (u. a. Node.js/TypeScript-Services, Datenbanken, AWS-Umgebung), die bargeldlose Zahlungen zuverlässig, sicher und skalierbar macht.
  • Du bringst dich aktiv in Architekturentscheidungen ein und denkst mit, wie sich Bling Schule technisch weiterentwickeln sollte, statt nur Tickets abzuarbeiten.
  • Du stehst im direkten Austausch mit unseren Kund:innen, sammelst Feedback aus dem Schul- und Kita-Alltag und setzt daraus Lösungen um, die einen echten Unterschied machen.
  • Du übernimmst Ownership für die Themen, die du mitgestaltest – inklusive Code-Qualität, Tests und einem sauberen, wartbaren Setup.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast bereits praktische Erfahrung als Full Stack Web Developer gesammelt und schon einmal eigenverantwortlich Software gebaut, von der Idee bis zum Release, egal ob im Job oder in einem eigenen App- bzw. Software-Projekt.
  • Du bringst Kenntnisse in modernen Web-Technologien mit (z. B. TypeScript/JavaScript, Node.js, React oder vergleichbar) und bist bereit dich schnell in neue Themen einzuarbeiten.
  • Erste Berührungspunkte mit AWS oder anderer Cloud-Infrastruktur sind ein Plus – aber kein Muss. Uns ist wichtiger, dass du bereit bist, dich hier reinzuarbeiten, als dass du schon alles kannst.
  • Du hast Lust, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, denkst mit statt nur umzusetzen, und bringst dich lieber aktiv mit eigenen Ideen ein, als auf Anweisungen zu warten.
  • Du liebst es, Dinge zu bauen, bist stolz auf sauberes Engineering und bringst genau dieses Mindset auch bei unklaren oder sich wandelnden Anforderungen mit.

Was dich erwartet

  • Gestalte den ersten bargeldlosen Payment-Dienstleister für Schulen und Kitas aktiv mit und übernimm echte Verantwortung dafür, wie Schulen, Kitas und Familien ihren Zahlungsal

Dein künftiger Arbeitgeber ist eines der führenden IT-Beratungshäuser im deutschsprachigen Raum – technikgetrieben, mittelständisch geprägt und mit GenAI als Top-Priorität des gesamten Unternehmens. In dieser Rolle bist du der Brückenbauer zwischen Modell und Produktion: Du bringst AI dorthin, wo sie am schwersten und am wertvollsten ist – in geschäftskritische Enterprise-Anwendungen. Zur Ehrlichkeit gehört: Das ist kundengetriebene Projektarbeit mit Workshops, Angebotsunterstützung und wechselnden Einsätzen von drei bis sechs Monaten. title: Software Engineer, Platform - Berlin, Germany
description:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.  

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

The responsibilities of our Platform team include building and maintaining all backend services, including, but not limited to, payments, analytics, subscriptions, new products, text to speech, and external APIs.

This is a key role and ideal for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys fast-paced environments, is passionate about making product decisions, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount. 

Our interview process involves several technical interviews and we aim to complete them within 1 week. 

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust APIs including public TTS API, internal APIs like Payment, Subscription, Auth and Consumption Tracking, ensuring they meet business and scalability requirements

  • Collaborate on B2B solutions, focusing on customization and integration needs for enterprise clients
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to align backend architecture with overall product strategy and user experience

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • Proven experience in backend development: TS/Node (required)

  • Preferred: Experience with Docker

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
About the role

Peec AI is building the data plane for AI visibility: millions of chats, scrapes, citations, sources, model responses, and customer-facing insights running through a fast-moving backend.

This role is for an engineer who wants to own the systems behind that. You will not just add endpoints or close tickets. You will make our scraping, chat-processing, source-ingestion, and analytics infrastructure more reliable, cheaper, faster, and easier for the rest of the team to reason about.

The best fit looks like someone who can debug a provider outage in the morning, design a better queueing model before lunch, ship a TypeScript service change in the afternoon, and write the postmortem or follow-up ticket clearly enough that the next engineer immediately knows what to do.

We are especially interested in people who have built or operated systems with real constraints: rate limits, flaky third-party APIs, queues, webhooks, retries, distributed locks, data migrations, observability gaps, customer pressure, and cost ceilings.

What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years of backend, platform, infrastructure, or distributed systems engineering experience in a production environment.

  • Deep hands-on TypeScript experience. We run TypeScript services on Bun, and we care about people who can design clean, reliable backend systems rather than only write application code.

description:
About ScholarshipOwl

ScholarshipOwl is the largest scholarship marketplace in the US, using AI to connect 14 million students who are looking for scholarships with companies that are looking for students. Our mission is to make education financing more accessible and engaging, while giving brands a way to connect with the next generation.

We’re powered by AI technology that simplifies scholarship discovery, streamlines the application process, and delivers measurable results for both students and partners. Whether it’s helping students secure funding or enabling brands to run impactful campaigns, we’re reshaping how education is funded — and discovered.


The Role

We’re looking for a highly skilled and innovative Senior Full-Stack Engineer to architect high-performance web applications and accelerate our development velocity across our B2B platform. You’ll play a pivotal role in bridging modern Nuxt 3/4 frontend applications—including customer management portals and embeddable widget engines—with a robust Laravel and Doctrine ORM backend API, delivering seamless experiences that connect millions of students to funding opportunities.

You will own the technical implementation of core products across our entire stack, working with PHP 8.2+, Laravel, MySQL, and Vue 3 / Nuxt 3/4. Beyond traditional engineering, this role champions efficiency: you will deeply integrate AI-native workflows (using tools like Cursor and Google Gemini) to double shipping velocity, automate test coverage, and build intelligent LLM-driven platform features. If you are passionate about full-stack architecture, widget infrastructure, and leveraging AI to build smarter and faster, this role is for you.

Your mission is to design and maintain a scalable, asynchronous backend that powers OKAPI:Orbits' end-to-end solutions across mission design, Space Situational Awareness (SSA), Space Traffic Management (STM), Flight Dynamics (FD), and Space Traffic Coordination (STC), supporting satellite operators throughout their entire mission lifecycle.

The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data, and we're hiring a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to build the platform that catches data problems before they become business problems.

About Us

Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing.

Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo.

  • Validate data accuracy, integrity, and consistency across services using SQL queries against PostgreSQL and MySQL.
  • Test REST and gRPC APIs using tools such as Postman, grpcurl, or equivalent solutions, validating requests, responses, error handling, and edge cases.
  • Verify event-driven workflows across message brokers such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, and NATS, including retries, failures, ordering, and duplicate-message handling.

Odin is building the investment infrastructure for the future of private markets.

title: Member of Technical Staff (EMEA)
description:
About Us:

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

The Role:


As a Member of Technical Staff on the EMEA field team, you build on top of one of the largest inference platforms in the world. The work spans the stack: capabilities on top of inference and serving, tooling around fine-tuning and post-training of LLMs, and the product our region’s customers need that the core platform team will not take on. You are first and foremost an excellent software engineer; that is what we are testing for. You prefer building product to being customer-facing, and that is exactly right for this role, though you are welcome to join customer work when it interests you.

 

Treat this as a flexible role: a bucket for exceptional builders at different levels of experience rather than a fixed job spec. There is no specific seniority requirement; anywhere from 3 to 10 years of experience can fit.

 

What we value most is first principles thinking: reasoning about unfamiliar problems from the ground up rather than from playbooks. You will be evaluated on this directly in the interview process, and strength here can outweigh gaps elsewhere in your background.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Build: Design and ship product capabilities end to end, from ambiguous need to running in production.

  • Build on Inference: Create capabilities on top of the serving stack: routing, model controls, observability, and whatever a deployment turns out to need.

  • Build on Training: Ship tooling around fine-tuning and post-training of LLMs, from data pipelines to evaluation, working alongside our applied ML engineers.

  • Own Regional Capability: Turn EMEA-specific requirements into product, working with core platform where the line is unclear.

  • Engineering Quality: Set the engineering bar for the regional team; your code is the reference.

title: Director of Finance (all genders)
description:
About us

Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and is headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

The opportunity

We are searching for a Director of Finance to lead our Accounting and Finance function. The Finance team offers a unique opportunity as you spend time in diverse markets like Asia, Europe, and LATAM. As we are still relatively early on our journey, you can really shape the future of Distribusion with us. This position will report directly to the Distribusion CFO.

  • Lead, manage and further develop the Accounting and Finance function, ensuring the achievement of objectives and delivering high-quality work.

  • Accountability for financial operations, including Invoicing, Accounting, Controlling, budgeting, liquidity and cash flow management.

  • Manage clearing and settlement on a global scale.

  • Continuously monitor and drive process improvements within the Accounting and Finance function, leveraging automation and technology (software systems) to streamline workflows and increase efficiency

  • Organise structured internal and external reporting that is compliant with all relevant financial regulations and reporting requirements

  • Build and maintain effective relationships with Banks, Accounting Offices, Financial Authorities, and other stakeholders, and oversee external service providers

  • Monitor and manage the company's cash flow and foreign exchange, ensuring that there is adequate liquidity to meet the company's obligations

  • Monitor and analyse key financial metrics, providing insights and recommendations to senior management for informed decision-making

title: Site Reliability Engineers (SRE)
description:

You will join a team working with Observability, Escalations, Post-mortems, Correction of Errors, and other practices that will contribute to the company's goal of cloud resiliency. You will be responsible for driving processes around reliability, best practices, cultural change, and enforcement of these practices.

  • Conduct Chaos Engineering experiments and relevant exercises to improve resiliency and fault-tolerance

  • Stay up to date and provide training on new and current technologies, services, tools, methodologies, and practices

title: IT | OT Security Architekt (m/w/d)

Die APT-ONE GmbH in Berlin ist ein auf Cyber Security spezialisiertes Beratungshaus. Wir schützen die IT-, OT-, Cloud- und KI-Systeme unserer Kunden wirksam vor digitalen Bedrohungen.

Unser Ansatz ist anders: KI-gestützte Werkzeuge übernehmen Discovery, Routine-Analysen und Mustererkennung – unsere Berater:innen validieren, interpretieren und konzentrieren sich auf Strategie und maßgeschneiderte Lösungen. Das ergibt tiefere Analysen und belastbare Entscheidungsgrundlagen in kürzerer Zeit, bei 40–60 % weniger Aufwand für Routinearbeit.

KI nur mit höchster Sensibilität für Kundendaten: Datenschutz steht über jedem Effizienzgewinn. KI ausschließlich auf vertraglich abgesicherten, datenschutzkonformen Plattformen, minimierte und anonymisierte Daten, niemals Kundendaten im Modelltraining. Diesen Umgang – und die Bereitschaft,
unsere Prozesse und Produkte kontinuierlich mit KI weiterzuentwickeln – erwarten wir von allen Berater:innen.

Bei uns bist du richtig, wenn:

  • du ein attraktives Fixgehalt plus überdurchschnittliche Gewinnbeteiligung willst.
  • du ortsunabhängig an hochrelevanten Projekten in Security Operations und KI-Sicherheit arbeiten willst.
  • du KI als Hebel siehst und Sicherheitsberatung neu denken willst – ohne Kompromisse beim Datenschutz.
  • du deine Expertise in SOC-Plattformen, Detection Engineering und Automatisierung ausbauen willst.

Aufgaben

  • Entwurf und Weiterentwicklung von Sicherheitsarchitekturen über IT-, OT-, Cloud- und KI-Systeme hinweg
  • Design sicherer Cloud- und Hybrid-Architekturen (Azure, AWS, GCP) inkl. Landing Zones, Identity- und Netzwerkdesign, Verschlüsselung und Security Baselines
  • Erstellung von Zielarchitekturen, Security-Roadmaps und Migrationspfaden – insbesondere für Cloud-Transformationen und Multi-Cloud-Szenarien
  • Durchführung von Threat Modeling, Architektur-Reviews und Risikoanalysen für Anwendungen, Netzwerke, Cloud-Workloads und Plattformen
  • Design von Netzwerk- und Perimetersicherheit inkl. Segmentierung, Firewalling und Zero Trust Network Access – On-Premises und in der Cloud
  • Konzeption von IAM- und PAM-Architekturen sowie von Kryptografie- und PKI-Konzepten, inkl. Cloud-nativer Identity- und Key-Management-Dienste
  • Bewertung und Absicherung von Cloud-Plattformdiensten, Container-/Kubernetes-Umgebungen und CI/CD-Pipelines (DevSecOps)
  • Definition von Security-Anforderungen an Projekte, Produkte, Cloud-Provider und Dienstleister
  • Übersetzung regulatorischer Anforderungen (NIS2, DORA, ISO 27001, BSI IT-Grundschutz, BSI C5) in technische Vorgaben und prüfbare Kontrollen

title: Software Engineer, Platform
description:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.  

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. 

Overview

The Platform team owns the backend behind everything Speechify ships: the public TTS API, payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and analytics — serving over 50 million users across iOS, Android, Mac, Chrome, and web.

These are systems where correctness compounds. Subscription state has to stay consistent across five clients and two app-store billing systems that each go quiet at the worst moment. Consumption metering has to be exact enough to bill on and cheap enough to run at our request volume. The public TTS API has external customers with their own products depending on our latency and uptime. None of this degrades gracefully — it is either right, or someone gets charged twice.

The job is to make your own job smaller. Every system you own here should need less of you a year from now than it did the day you took it, and the reward for that is a larger one. That is the entire growth path on this team — there is no separate ladder, and no ceiling except the one you stop raising. We are a flat organization: people become leaders here by taking scope and being right about it, fast.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and own the APIs behind payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and our public TTS API
  • Take on services you didn't write and make them faster, cheaper, and harder to break
  • Establish that a change is correct before it ships, and leave behind the checks that keep it correct after you've moved on
  • Automate the parts of your role that shouldn't need a person, then go take on what that freed you up for
  • Turn work you've done once into work the whole team can repeat
  • Design B2B and enterprise integrations for customers building on top of us

title: Cloud Security Engineer

title: Werkstudent KI & Automatisierung (m/w/d)
description:
Prozesse verstehen. Lösungen bauen, die bei KMUs tatsächlich laufen.

Warum es diese Stelle gibt

Wir sind ein kleines Team in Neumarkt und entwickeln IoT-Cloud-Lösungen für Maschinen- und Fahrzeughersteller. Parallel bauen wir eine Automatisierungsplattform, mit der wir Prozesse automatisieren – für uns selbst und für unsere Kunden. Mit KI-Agenten, LLM-Anbindungen und der Integration bestehender Fachsysteme.

Der Bedarf ist größer als das, was wir nebenbei erledigen können. Deshalb suchen wir jemanden, der genau daran arbeitet: bestehende Prozesse aufnehmen, verstehen wo es klemmt, und dann eine Lösung bauen, die läuft.

Was wir nicht suchen: jemanden, der Konzepte schreibt, die niemand umsetzt. Und keine Forschungsprojekte. Unsere Lösungen müssen zu einem Mittelständler passen – also einfach genug, dass sie auch ohne dich weiterlaufen.

Aufgaben

Was du machst

  • Prozesse aufnehmen. Du sprichst mit den Menschen, die einen Prozess täglich durchlaufen – bei uns oder beim Kunden. Du hältst fest, wie er heute wirklich läuft (nicht, wie er laut Handbuch laufen sollte), wo Zeit verloren geht und was am Ende besser sein soll.
  • Konzipieren. Du entscheidest, welcher Teil sich automatisieren lässt, wo KI echten Mehrwert bringt und wo eine einfache Regel genügt. Du schätzt Aufwand und Nutzen ab und legst dem Prozessowner eine Empfehlung vor – keine Optionsliste.
  • Umsetzen, hands-on. Du baust die Lösung selbst: KI-Agenten auf Basis von LLM-APIs, Automatisierungs-Workflows, Anbindung bestehender Systeme über REST-Schnittstellen und Webhooks, dazu die nötige Datenaufbereitung. Und ein Skript in Python oder JavaScript, wo Klicken nicht reicht.
  • Review und Übergabe. Du gehst mit dem Prozessowner durch, ob die Lösung im Alltag hält. Du prüfst nach, dokumentierst so, dass eine andere Person daran weiterarbeiten kann, und übergibst sauber.

Qualifikation

Was du mitbringen musst

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch. Du führst Prozessgespräche mit Anwendern und Prozessownern, teils bei Kunden im Mittelstand. Das geht nicht auf Englisch. Verhandlungssicher heißt: du diskutierst frei, auch wenn es fachlich und sprachlich kompliziert wird.
  • Mindestens ein Tag pro Woche vor Ort in Neumarkt in der Oberpfalz. Prozessaufnahme funktioniert im Gespräch, nicht im Ticketsystem. Die übrige Zeit arbeitest du flexibel und remote.
  • Echte Begeisterung für KI und erste eigene Erfahrung damit. Kein Zertifikat, kein Studienschwerpunkt – aber du musst schon einmal selbst etwas mit KI gebaut haben. Ein Agent, ein LLM-Workflow, ein Chatbot auf eigenen Daten, ein Automatisierungsskript mit angebundenem Modell. Wir fragen im Gespräch danach, und zwar im Detail.

Dazu:

  • laufendes Studium – Wirtschaf

description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Synthesia Roleplay Sessions is a training tool that lets people practice real conversations with AI avatars. Instead of just watching training videos, learners do interactive roleplay exercises, like practicing a sales pitch or handling a customer complaint with an AI coach. Managers can use a dashboard to track which employees have completed their training, see how well they performed, and measure if the training actually improved their skills. The whole platform is built around learning by doing rather than just passive video watching.

For your ML engineer role, you'd be building the AI engine that makes the coaching work. That means creating the models that listen to what learners say during roleplay, score their performance, generate helpful feedback in real time, and decide how the AI avatar should respond next based on what the learner does.

This is an applied ML position, not a research one. We expect you to have a good understanding of ML but on the other side to be a good product-focused software developer as you will be expected to work on different products.

title: Senior AI Engineer – Notebooks

description:
About us

We’re Cortea, a Berlin startup transforming audits with AI. Manual, document-heavy audits waste expert time while demand keeps rising. Our AI-powered software and specialized AI agents remove the repetitive work so auditors can focus on judgment.

Backed by top-tier VCs with >15m funding, with a working product and paying customers, we’re rapidly scaling.

We value first-principles thinking, speed, trust, and kindness. We build side by side in our Berlin office.

Your Role

We're looking for an experienced engineer who's happy anywhere in the stack and turns complex audit workflows into product auditors rely on every day. You pick up whatever a problem needs, from the data model to the interface to the agents behind it.

A lot of what we build has no reference implementation. You're comfortable wading into something nobody has solved yet and shipping a first version that actually works.

Our engineering team is a small, flat group of builders: strong ICs who open a laptop when they see a problem instead of scheduling a meeting. Everyone owns real product and architecture decisions, and that's exactly what we want more of.

What you'll do

  • Build the interfaces auditors work in, partnering with design to turn complex flows into something that feels effortless

  • Build and improve the agents at the core of the product, plus the harnesses and eval pipelines around them

  • Make the long-running workflows behind the product reliable and debuggable, so failures surface fast instead of silently

  • Use AI heavily in your own workflow to move faster, without ever shipping output you can't stand behind

  • Drive the how in RFCs and technical discussions with other engineers, and partner with product on the what

Qualifications

You'll fit here if you:

  • Have 5+ years shipping production web applications across the stack

  • Write production APIs and model the data behind them so it holds up under multi-tenancy and load

  • Are strong on the frontend and can build genuinely complex UI

  • Get how LLM agents actually work: agents, harnesses, tool use, and measuring quality with evals

title: Solutions Architect, Lead
description:
About Notabene

Notabene is building infrastructure that’s transforming how money moves in the digital economy. We’re evolving beyond our compliance foundations to enable the next generation of digital financial services between regulated institutions with unprecedented efficiency. With nearly 50 employees across 14 countries and having recently closed our Series B round last November with support from leading investors including Y Combinator, DRW, F-Prime, Jump Capital, Castle Island, and Green Visor Capital, we’re looking for people like you to help shape the future rails of the crypto industry.

Location: Remote

The impact you will have:

Notabene is moving up-market. Our growth now comes from financial institutions and fintechs launching digital asset products. These are bigger customers with longer implementation cycles, more stakeholders and higher contract values than the crypto-native exchanges we grew up with.

You will own a small number of these customers. Sales closes the initial deal and hands the customer over at signature. From there they are yours: get them live, get them using the product, renew them and grow them.

Growth is the part of this role that matters most. One signed contract is a way into the rest of the organisation. You will map it, find the other teams, entities and regions that need us, and work with Sales to open them.

You are also the technical point of contact for your customers. Enterprise conversations get technical early, and you should be able to sit with a customer's integration team and be useful without a Solutions Engineer in the room. Comfort with APIs and the curiosity to work things out yourself matter more here than an engineering background.

Responsibilities

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Technical Product Lead - AI Stockbroking
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 

What You'll Own

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits,

title: Founder’s Associate
description:
🏢 Who we are

A team from Germany with the vision to make advanced network security accessible for everyone

We are a software company developing an open source zero-trust network security platform that is both easy to use and affordable for teams of all sizes and budgets. Our mission is grounded in a simple yet powerful belief: secure private networking is a fundamental right of every modern company.

Since our launch on GitHub in 2021, we have gained trust among thousands of companies seeking secure and seamless solutions for connecting remote employees and infrastructure. By replacing traditional centralized VPNs, NetBird has become a trusted choice for modern network security, connecting today hundreds of thousands of users and machines worldwide. Our open source, community-driven approach has been a key driver of our success. We listen to our users, and their input helps us make network security better for everyone.

Specifically, you will:

  • Own strategic projects across growth, product, operations, and fundraising end to end, from first analysis to shipped result

  • Help grow the team, from running recruiting operations to winning exceptional people for NetBird

  • Research markets, competitors, and customer needs to identify new opportunities and risks before they become obvious

  • Drive cross-team initiatives and keep Product, Growth, and Engineering aligned on critical company milestones

  • Design and improve the internal processes that keep a scaling company running, and take ownership of whatever matters most right now, from testing new GTM ideas to unblocking the founders

🔎 What we are looking for

We're looking for an exceptional generalist: highly motivated, analytical, and hands-on, with the ambition to help build and scale a tech startup from the inside.

title: Technical Product Lead - AI Stockbroking
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits,

(Fully remote, async-first, DevTools SaaS, 40h/week, time zones: UTC-3 to UTC+3)

Über reisewitz

reisewitz entwickelt seit 1984 intelligente Planungssoftware und ist europaweit für seine Kunden im Einsatz. Mit adelo® (Tourenplanung & Workforce Management), optaflow® (mobile Zählerkommunikation) und aures (automatische Disposition) steuern über 150 Kunden ihre Serviceteams – darunter Hardeck, BoConcept, Wiener Netze und zahlreiche Stadtwerke. Wir sind ISO 27001 zertifiziert und wurden 2024 mit dem Sust-Award für nachhaltige Routenplanung ausgezeichnet.

Unsere Software liefern wir nicht als Datenträger aus, sondern als Service — wir hosten sie selbst.

Deine Mission

Du betreust unser Hosting-Geschäft — als die Person, die diesen Bereich übernimmt, mit klar abgegrenztem Verantwortungsbereich und direktem Draht zum CIO. Die Plattform, auf der unsere Kunden täglich ihre Touren planen und ihre Monteure steuern, läuft auf Infrastruktur, die du verantwortest: eine wachsende Hetzner-VPS-Landschaft, unsere Virtualisierungsumgebungen samt Firewall sowie die dazugehörigen Netz-, Storage- und Backup-Schichten.

Dabei stehst du nicht vor einer fertigen Landschaft: Die Migration von VMware auf Proxmox VE ist beschlossen und startet gerade — du begleitest sie mit und übernimmst danach den operativen Betrieb des Clusters. Wenn du Lust darauf hast, wächst die Rolle mittelfristig um eine Beratungs-Komponente: Unterstützung unserer Kunden bei deren eigenen Proxmox- und Hosting-Vorhaben — Architektur, Migration, Schulung.

Was dich bei uns erwartet

  • Übernahme des laufenden Betriebs unserer Hetzner-VPS-Infrastruktur: Provisionierung, Patching, Härtung, Monitoring, Kostenkontrolle.

  • Ehrliche Bestandsaufnahme der Backup-Lage: Was ist wirklich wiederherstellbar? Der erste echte Restore-Test ist dein Projekt.

Danach — Migration & Ausbau

  • Begleitung der VMware→Proxmox-Migration und nach Abschluss operative Verantwortung für den Cluster: Pflege, Updates, Storage- und Netzwerkkonfiguration.

  • Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung der Umgebungen, in denen unsere SaaS-Plattform für übe

title: ML Research Engineer
description:
TLDR: We are looking for several ML Engineers to train, post-train, and evaluate the LLMs at the core of our platform. This is hands-on modern model training work: large-scale data pipelines, SFT/RLHF/DPO-style alignment, reward models, distributed multi-GPU training, and evaluation.

About us

White Circle is an AI Safety company building the safety, reliability, and optimization layer for AI systems. At the core of our platform are policies – simple natural-language rules that define what an AI model should and shouldn’t do. We automatically test, enforce, and continuously improve these policies at scale.

  • We’ve raised $11M from top funds, founders, and senior leaders at OpenAI, Anthropic, HuggingFace, Mistral, DeepMind, Datadog, Sentry, and others

  • We process over 100M+ API calls every month

  • We fine-tune and train our own LLMs so they run faster and cheaper than any open or proprietary model

We’re a small, highly focused team. If you want to work deeply on hard problems, see your work ship to production quickly, and influence how AI safety is actually built – you’re the one we need.

 

You will:

  • Turn petabytes of unstructured text into a structured, explorable view (topics, clusters, segments, trends, anomalies): iterate from “unknown unknowns” to stable definitions we can track.

  • Build scalable representation pipelines: sampling strategies, preprocessing/normalization, embeddings at scale, indexing, and retrieval to make the corpus searchable and analyzable.

  • Use LLMs pragmatically: labeling/classification, weak supervision, data enrichment, summarization, and automated diagnostics of inbound volumes (with cost/quality controls).

  • Deliver insights that change decisions: translate findings into product and operational actions (what data we have, what’s missing, where quality breaks, what to prioritize next).

  • Ship self-serve analytics: datasets, data models, and lightweight tools/dashboards so the team can explore and answer questions without ad-hoc requests.

  • Partner closely with engineering/research: align pipelines with production constraints (latency/cost/privacy), and integrate outputs into workflows.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Norman builds an AI agent that helps small businesses manage invoicing, accounting, and taxes. We are a small team based in Berlin.

As our Customer Success Manager, you will be the first point of contact for people who want to understand and use Norman. You'll spend most of your time on calls with inbound leads from our website and new customers. You will understand their needs, show relevant features, and guide their first steps. You will also work with the product team to improve what does not yet work well for customers.

Full-time, remote within Germany.

Tasks

• Lead product demos and onboarding calls in German, tailored to each person's questions and workflows.

• Understand what inbound leads need, explain honestly whether Norman fits, and help suitable customers get started.

• Guide new customers through setup and their first tasks so they can use the product independently.

• Answer follow-up questions, agree on next steps, and keep track of open issues and commitments.

• Use the product yourself, try new features, and report problems to the product team with clear examples.

• Document recurring questions, objections and friction, and turn them into better demos, help content and onboarding flows.

Requirements

• Native-level spoken and written German: you can lead natural, confident customer conversations and explain complex workflows clearly.

• Experience working directly with customers in customer success, onboarding, consulting, support or inbound sales.

• Strong listening skills: you ask useful questions and explain software patiently without jargon.

• Ability to learn a product quickly and curiosity about why customers get stuck.

• Reliable organization: you manage calls, notes and next steps independently and follow through on commitments.

• Good English for working with the team.

• Based in Germany and available full-time for customer calls during German business hours.

Nice to have:

• Experience with SaaS, fintech, or software for the self-employed and small businesses.

• Familiarity with invoicing, bookkeeping, or German tax workflows; a tax qualification is not required.

• Experience giving product demos, using a CRM, or writing help articles.

Benefits

• Work remotely.

• Work directly with founders in a small team and help shape how customers experience Norman.

• Turn customer feedback into product improvements you can see.

• Own customer conversations from the first demo through onboarding, with no current sales quota or commission.

Want to help people get started with Norman? Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note about your customer-facing experience. Tell us why this role interests you and how you have helped someone understand or use a product. We look forward to hearing from you.

Endear is building the first modern CRM for retail teams. We empower brands to drive more in-store sales by giving their retail teams AI-powered tools to have 10x more personalized, human conversations with customers. Despite retail being 6x larger than eCommerce, brick-and-mortar retail has been largely overlooked by the technology industry. We're changing that by enabling thousands of salespeople to leverage customer data in meaningful ways.

Founded 5 years ago, Endear has demonstrated strong product-market fit and reached profitability multiple times. Our platform was built from the ground up by technical leaders who have scaled data platforms to hundreds of millions of users and been at startups from early-stage through IPO. We make measured, high-conviction decisions at every milestone to ensure long-term success while realizing our massive potential in the retail market.

Our Work Environment

  • Remote-first culture built on trust and autonomy

  • Small, highly effective team (20-ish employees)

  • Fast-paced environment with shifting priorities

  • High-ownership culture where outcomes matter

You have a solutions-first approach to helping customers, with an eye on how support can result in upsells, referrals, and expansion

N2JSoft est une Fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la gestion des dépenses professionnelles.

Buscamos un/a SEO Copywriter con perfil estratégico y creativo para desarrollar contenido orientado al mercado francés.

La persona será responsable de crear y optimizar contenidos que mejoren el posicionamiento orgánico, aumenten el tráfico cualificado y contribuyan a la generación de leads.   • Francés nativo o equivalente, con excelente capacidad de redacción y ortografía.
  • Experiencia previa como SEO Copywriter, SEO Content Writer, Content Writer o en un rol similar.

  • Experiencia realizando keyword research y trabajando con intención de búsqueda.

  • Capacidad para interpretar datos y convertir insights en acciones concretas de contenido.
  • Excelente capacidad de escritura, storytelling y adaptación del contenido a diferentes audiencias.
  • Organización y autonomía para gestionar múltiples contenidos o proyectos simultáneamente.
  • Capacidad para trabajar de forma remota y colaborar con equipos multidisciplinarios.

Será un plus

  • Experiencia trabajando con empresas SaaS, tecnología o marketplaces.
  • Conocimientos de inbound marketing y marketing automation.
  • Experiencia trabajando con Word

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
About Payflows

At Payflows, we build software that helps large companies manage and automate their payment workflows. It’s not the flashiest part of a business, but it’s one of the most critical: invoices, approvals, payments, and controls. When these things slow down, the whole company feels it.

But our ambition goes further than just building a better workflow tool.

We believe the future of finance operations is not faster clicking: it’s no clicking at all 🫳 🎤

Finance teams shouldn’t spend their days moving data from one screen to another. Software should do the operational work, and humans should focus on reviewing, approving, and making the decisions that matter.

That’s the direction we’re building toward: an agent-driven finance platform, where intelligent agents handle the repetitive tasks, and users stay in control.

We started in 2022 with a small team and a rough first version of the product. Three years later, we’re working with major companies across France, the UK, and the US while choosing to keep our team small and human-sized.

We moved fast, shipped a lot, and not everything was built in a perfect way. But it helped us learn quickly, sign real customers, and prove that the problem we’re solving truly matters.

In 2024, investors trusted us with a $25M Series A. That gives us the chance to keep growing while also strengthening our foundations and building the system that will power this agent-driven future.

Today, we’re about 35 people from many different countries, and we’re looking for a few amazing humans to join the next chapter. 🤗

🚀 What you’ll actually do

You’ll help build a product that real finance teams rely on every day.

For us, engineering is not just about clean code, it’s about reliability, clarity, and trust, especially when money and automation are involved.

In a typical week, you might:

  • Design and implement new services for a product feature.

title: Senior Software Developer (m/f/d) in CI
description:
Your mission

Are you a passionate Senior Software Developer (m/f/d), who wants every single one of your changes to make hundreds of engineering hours faster and more reliable? Are you tired of environments where CI is treated as an afterthought, a pile of scripts nobody owns, and where "the build is broken" is just accepted as normal? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you to join our CI team at Checkmk and make a real difference! At Checkmk, the Build & Test Platform is not plumbing, it is a product with developers as its users.

As our new Senior Developer (m/f/d) for our Build & Test Platform, your mission will be to design and build the Bazel-based build and test architecture that carries Checkmk's growth. We have ambitious and growing goals as a company, and that directly shapes our engineering environment. More developers, more tests, higher quality standards: the demands on our platform will keep increasing, year over year. Your job is to stay ahead of that curve, so that feedback stays fast, results stay trustworthy, and quality is caught before it reaches a customer. Here's what your journey with us will look like:

  • Build architecture: Own and evolve our Bazel setup across several concurrently maintained product versions. Drive hermeticity, sane dependency boundaries, and toolchain management, and plan migrations that improve the architecture without blocking the developers who depend on it every day.
  • Make it fast: Turn build and test times into something you measure and then attack. Remote caching and execution, cache hit rates and a good Pipeline architecture.

Plexal operates at the intersection of government, industry and emerging technology, helping organisations turn innovation ambition into practical capability, adoption and measurable impact.
 
The Senior Lead, Government Innovation & Economic Growth will play a critical role in shaping and delivering Plexal's growth across government. This is a nationally focused role responsible for identifying, shaping and securing high-value opportunities across central government, public sector organisations and strategic partners.

title: Head of Accounting (m/w/d) - Yunicorn Ventures

title: Talent Lead
description:
TL;DR: We’re looking for a hands-on Talent Lead to own and build our hiring function from scratch. You’ll personally drive hiring across the company, build scalable recruiting processes, track hiring performance, and work closely with the Head of People and hiring managers across GTM, Ops, Research, and Product.

 

About us

White Circle is an AI Safety company building the safety, reliability, and optimization layer for AI systems. At the core of our platform are policies – simple natural-language rules that define what an AI model should and shouldn’t do. We automatically test, enforce, and continuously improve these policies at scale.

  • We’ve raised $11M from top funds, founders, and senior leaders at OpenAI, Anthropic, HuggingFace, Mistral, DeepMind, Datadog, Sentry, and others

  • We process over one hundred million API calls every month

  • We fine-tune and train our own LLMs so they run faster and cheaper than any open or proprietary model

We’re a small, highly focused team. If you want to work deeply on hard problems, see your work ship to production quickly, and influence how AI safety is actually built – you’re the one we need.

 

You will:

  • Own and run the hiring process end-to-end (sourcing, screening, interviews, and closing)

  • Personally source and hire candidates across the company (this is a hands-on recruiting role)

  • Build our hiring processes and infrastructure from scratch, including interview loops, scorecards, pipelines, and candidate tracking

description:
Location: Remote in Europe

Salary: Competitive base + Commission

About Nivoda 🚀

Nivoda is a rapidly scaling global B2B diamond and gemstone marketplace connecting jewellery retailers with competitive, high-quality suppliers worldwide. Processing $300M+ in annual transactions and operating across multiple regions, Nivoda is transforming a $350B industry that has historically been slow to modernise.

Our platform gives businesses of all sizes, from independent jewellers to major retail chains access to the world's best diamond and gemstone inventory, without the traditional barriers of capital, geography, or information asymmetry.

Our Mission 🎯

Diamond and gemstone trading has long been plagued by inefficiency, opacity, and exclusivity. Nivoda was built to change that - to democratise access and empower every business, regardless of size or location, to buy and sell with confidence. Independent jewellers are at the heart of this mission. They deserve the same access to quality, pricing, and selection as the biggest players in the industry. That's exactly what we give them.

The Team ⭐️

Our Sales team is the engine that brings Nivoda's mission to life. We're a high-energy, globally distributed group that moves fast, owns outcomes, and genuinely cares about the success of every jewellery business we work with. This is a team that thrives on commercial creativity, deep customer relationships, and relentless execution and we're growing fast.

About the Role 🤔

You take a booked demo and turn it into a live, transacting Nivoda customer. That means running a compelling demo of the marketplace, navigating commercial negotiation, closing the contract, shepherding the customer through KYC/onboarding compliance, and owning the account through its first 90 days — first search, first order, first reorder.

This is not a pure "close and toss" role. The first 90 days are where marketplace customers form habits or churn silently, so you are accountable for activation, not just signature. You need to understand how two-sided marketplaces work — liquidity, supply trust, transaction mechanics — and ideally how the jewellery trade buys.

What will you be doing? 😎

  • Run discovery-led demos that map Nivoda's marketplace to the retailer's actual buying workflow.

  • Manage the deal: proposal, commercial terms, objection handli

title: Talent Lead
description:
TL;DR: We’re looking for a hands-on Talent Lead to own and build our hiring function from scratch. You’ll personally drive hiring across the company, build scalable recruiting processes, track hiring performance, and work closely with the Head of People and hiring managers across GTM, Ops, Research, and Product.

 

About us

White Circle is an AI Safety company building the safety, reliability, and optimization layer for AI systems. At the core of our platform are policies – simple natural-language rules that define what an AI model should and shouldn’t do. We automatically test, enforce, and continuously improve these policies at scale.

  • We’ve raised $11M from top funds, founders, and senior leaders at OpenAI, Anthropic, HuggingFace, Mistral, DeepMind, Datadog, Sentry, and others

  • We process over one hundred million API calls every month

  • We fine-tune and train our own LLMs so they run faster and cheaper than any open or proprietary model

We’re a small, highly focused team. If you want to work deeply on hard problems, see your work ship to production quickly, and influence how AI safety is actually built – you’re the one we need.

 

You will:

  • Own and run the hiring process end-to-end (sourcing, screening, interviews, and closing)

  • Personally source and hire candidates across the company (this is a hands-on recruiting role)

  • Build our hiring processes and infrastructure from scratch, including interview loops, scorecards, pipelines, and candidate tracking

  • Work closely with hiring managers to define roles, hiring priorities, and candidate profiles

  • Drive hiring across a wide range of functions, including GTM, Ops, Research, Product, and Engineering

  • Lead international hiring across the US, EU, UK, and other markets as we expand

  • Build and maintain hiring metrics and reporting, including pipeline conversion, time to hire, source performance, and offer acceptance

  • Use hiring data to identify bottlenecks and continuously improve the recruiting process

  • Build and maintain strong sourcing channels across different functions and geographies

title: Product Manager confirmé H/F - SaaS - Fintech
description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus RH et financiers. Avec plus de 20 000 clients et 1 million d’utilisateurs dans 98 pays, notre solution N2F s’impose comme une référence sur le marché français.

N2F est une plateforme complète de Spend Management (notes de frais, cartes corporate, factures fournisseurs, budget), conçue pour simplifier le quotidien des entreprises grâce à une expérience fluide, intuitive et 100 % connectée (web et mobile).

Portés par une équipe engagée, qui place l’humain au centre de ses priorités, nous poursuivons une ambition claire : devenir le leader européen de la gestion des dépenses professionnelles.

Pour accompagner cette croissance, nous recherchons un(e) Product Manager confirmé(e) pour rejoindre notre équipe Produit et prendre la responsabilité d’un domaine fonctionnel clé de notre plateforme. Le terrain de jeu est vaste et les défis nombreux : internationalisation, intelligence artificielle, agents, automatisation des workflows, interconnectivité, refonte fonctionnelle et amélioration continue de l’expérience utilisateur.

Tes principales missions :

Rattaché(e) à la VP Product, tu seras responsable d’un domaine fonctionnel de notre plateforme et de son évolution à long terme.

Stratégie de Produit :

  • Définir et porter la vision de ton domaine produit.

  • Comprendre en profondeur les besoins des clients, des utilisateurs et des équipes internes.

  • Analyser les tendances du marché, la concurrence et les évolutions technologiques afin d’identifier les meilleures opportunités de développement.

  • Participer à l’identification et à l’évaluation de nouveaux cas d’usage liés à l’IA, à l’automatisation et aux agents.

Gestion du Cycle de Vie du Produit :

  • Construire et piloter la roadmap de ton périmètre.

  • Identifier, qualifier et prioriser les opportunités en fonction de leur impact utilisateur et business.

company: Omilia Natural Language Solutions Ua Ltd
description:
About the company

Omilia is a leader in Conversational AI. Our cloud platform powers natural, human like customer conversations over voice and chat for some of the largest enterprises in banking, insurance, telecommunications and hospitality, handling hundreds of millions of interactions a year. We build our own deep tech across the stack, from speech recognition and natural language understanding to dialog management, and we integrate natively with the major CCaaS platforms. We are a company of roughly 500 people, distributed across Europe and North America, in the middle of an ambitious platform modernization program: Kubernetes everywhere, autoscaling for every service, a next generation observability stack, and AI woven through our own engineering lifecycle.

Role Purpose

The Account Executive, DACH drives new business growth for Omilia's Conversational AI platform across the German, Austrian, and Swiss markets. This role owns the full sales cycle for enterprise prospects in banking, insurance, healthcare, and utilities, from qualification through contract close, and is accountable for building a strong regional pipeline and consistently meeting revenue targets. The role acts as a trusted advisor to prospects, translating complex CX automation capabilities into clear business value for DACH enterprises.

Accountabilities

  • Own individual revenue targets for the DACH region and deliver consistent, predictable quota attainment.
  • Build and maintain a qualified pipeline of enterprise prospects across banking, insurance, healthcare, and utilities in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.
  • Lead the end-to-end sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery through solution positioning, negotiation, and contract close.
  • Represent Omilia's value proposition accurately and credibly to C-level and senior stakeholders at prospect organizations.
  • Maintain accurate forecasting and pipeline data to support regional sales planning led by the VP of Sales, DACH.
  • Build long-term relationships with key accounts to support expansion opportunities post-close.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prospect and qualify new enterprise opportunities within the DACH region through outbound efforts, referrals, and inbound leads.
  • Conduct discovery calls to understand prospect business challenges, CX automation needs, and technical requirements.
  • Coordinate with Solutions Consulting and Pre-Sales teams to deliver tailored product demonstrations and proofs of concept.
  • Develop and present business cases, ROI models, and proposals aligned to prospect priorities.
  • Negotiate commercial terms and contracts in coordination with Legal and Finance, within approved guidelines.
  • Maintain up-to-date opportunity records, forecasts, and activity data in the CRM.
  • Collaborate with Marketing on regional campaigns, events, and localized content for the DACH market.

title: Senior Research Associate
description:
ABOUT MORE IN COMMON

LOCATION: London (Monday-Thursday in the office, Friday remote) 
CONTRACT: Full-time
SALARY: £36,000-£46,000 
START DATE: As soon as possible

More in Common is a research agency working across the US, UK, Germany, France, Spain and Poland to tackle polarisation and division. More in Common leads and supports initiatives to build more united, inclusive, and resilient societies. Our mission is to understand the forces driving us apart, help societies find common ground and bring people together to tackle shared challenges. 
 
In the UK, our work is best described as being part consultancy and part think tank. We provide a full suite of research services including polling and focus group research; evidence reviews and secondary data analysis; audience mapping and audience strategy; strategic communications strategy and campaign development. More in Common are members of the British Polling Council. 
 
Our work is informed by our ground-breaking segmentation of the British public. This unique values-based lens to our quantitative and qualitative research means we can understand not only what the public thinks of the big challenges facing British society today – but crucially why they think it. Our insights help leaders in government, the media, business, and civil society to develop better strategies and communications – particularly in reaching disengaged communities far from the Westminster/London bubble – and to better navigate tricky and divisive issues. 
 
Over the last year, More in Common has published agenda-setting thought leadership on a whole range of debates facing British society – including exploring the public’s starting points on assisted dying and immigration; understanding how the British public is navigating major debates from trans and gender identity to the conflict in Israel and Palestine; and our political research has helped policymakers and politicians understand the dramatic fragmentation of our politics. Our work is regularly covered in the British press and media and we’ve developed a series of partnerships with broadcasters and newspapers to deliver top-quality research insights. In the 2024 General Election, we were among Britain’s most accurate pollsters and used our focus group research to put people and public opinion at the centre of coverage of the election campaign.
 
Through our consultancy, More in Common has also supported dozens of partners with insights and strategic communications support. We’ve helped national institutions such as the BBC, British Library and National Trust to better understand their audiences, we’ve helped partners in government and civil society with the set-up and delivery of the Homes for Ukraine scheme, and we’ve supported a range of partners to test their policy proposals from the National Farmers Union to Rethink Mental Illness among m

title: Director of Sales, Europe
Payroll Specialist
description:
Frontline work keeps the world running. Restaurants, hospitals, schools, nurseries, airlines, stores, emergency services. Together they employ 80% of the global workforce, over 3 billion people, and they're among the hardest businesses anywhere to run. By-the-minute scheduling, HR and payroll make them far more operationally complex than the average office, yet just 1% of venture funding has ever gone to software built for them.

 

Rising costs, wage increases, labour shortages and tighter regulation have made fixing that urgent. Sona is the AI-native workforce management platform for frontline organisations, with agents that match staffing to real demand and take the admin load off managers. That's a $500bn+ market the software industry has mostly walked past.

 

We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here.

 

About the Role

 

We're hiring a Payroll Specialist to join Sona's payroll bureau, taking hands-on ownership of UK payroll processing for a portfolio of our customers.

Our bureau is growing fast. We're moving from around 15,000 payslips a month to roughly 22,000 by the start of Q4, driven by new customer go-lives in hospitality and care. That means the pace of the role is genuinely high, and we're hiring ahead of that curve rather than catching up after the fact.

Day to day, you'll manage a portfolio of standard and mid-complexity clients across multiple pay frequencies: statutory payments, pension auto-enrolment, HMRC filings and payroll journal reconciliation. You'll also handle client queries through our support desk, working to fast turnaround times. Your work is checked by a Senior Payroll Specialist before it reaches clients, as part of our standard quality process.

This isn't a conventional bureau role. Sona is a startup and the payroll team is still building its own processes and tools, so there's genuine room to shape how things work and to grow as the bureau scales. You'll be working on a product in a sector most software has ignored, and once you're through probation we support CIPP study through the apprenticeship levy.

title: Product Manager – Growth & Innovation (all genders) - 100% Home Office
description:
Gestalte die digitale Zukunft mit fino digital!

fino hat seine Wurzeln im ersten digitalen und vollautomatisierten Kontowechsel der FinTech-Branche. Seit der Gründung im Jahr 2015 hat sich fino stetig weiterentwickelt und ist heute der marktführende Innovationstreiber in den Bereichen Konto- und Datenanalyse, Regulatorik, Steuern und Dokumentenmanagement. Mit maßgeschneiderten Lösungen schafft fino für seine Kunden und Partner neue Perspektiven für Geschäftsmodelle im B2B- und B2B2C-Bereich.

Wir bei fino digital sind überzeugt, dass datengetriebenen Geschäftsmodellen die Zukunft gehört. Unsere Mission ist es, Daten einen Wert zu geben und sie durch intelligente Data-Analytics-Lösungen in hochwertige Insights zu verwandeln. Mit über 240 Millionen durchgeführten Transaktionsanalysen und Kooperationen mit mehr als 1.000 Banken sowie 10.000 weiteren Partnern, darunter renommierte Namen wie Sparkassen, VR-Banken, DATEV und Schufa, genießen wir das Vertrauen zahlreicher Unternehmen und Institutionen.

Möchtest du Teil dieses innovativen Teams werden und die digitale Zukunft aktiv mitgestalten? Dann bewirb dich jetzt bei fino digital!

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest die Produktvision und Roadmap für unsere Kontowechsel-Produkte und entwickelst diese kontinuierlich weiter – von neuen Features bis hin zu ganz neuen Produktkonzepten
  • Du spürst Chancen für neue Use Cases und europaweite Märkte auf, bringst eigene Ideen ein und treibst sie mit Überzeugung bis zur Umsetzung voran
  • Du priorisierst dein Backlog klar und datenbasiert und sorgst dafür, dass dein Team genau an den Themen arbeitet, die den größten Wachstum schaffen
  • Du übersetzt die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden und Partner im europäischen Markt in konkrete, umsetzbare Produktanforderungen
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Managing Director Banking als Sparringspartner zusammen und entwickelst gemeinsam die Produktausrichtung weiter
  • Du misst den Erfolg deiner Entscheidungen an klaren Kennzahlen und leitest daraus die nächsten Schritte ab

Deine Qualifikationen

  • Du bringst mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als Growth Manager, Product Owner oder Produktmanager (all genders) mit, idealerweise im FinTech- oder Banking-Umfeld
  • Du denkst unternehmerisch, hast ein starkes Gespür für datengetriebene Produkte und triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von Zahlen und echten Nutzerbedürfnissen
  • Du bringst eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität mit, übernimmst Verantwortung und bringst deine Themen eigenständig ins Ziel
  • Du bringst idealerweise bereits Erfahrung in internationalen bzw. europäischen Märkten mit und hast Freude daran, Produkte auch über Ländergrenzen hinweg zu denken
  • Du kommunizierst klar und überzeugend gegenüber dem Team ebenso wie gegenüber Kunden und der Geschäftsführung
  • Du sprichst Deutsch und Englisch verhandlun

title: Product & Business Analyst
description:
Launch your product career at Europe's leading music education platform

Matchspace Music is Europe's leading music education platform. We help thousands of music teachers build sustainable careers from teaching, and we are scaling fast across international markets. You will work directly with our VP Product.

This is a role for someone hungry. You want to see how a product is discovered, specified, built, shipped, measured and improved, and you want to be hands-on across the whole cycle. Everything we build follows one cycle: build, measure, learn, repeat. We are looking for a sharp analytical mind that is also creative in solving problems and providing fresh insights. In return you get a front-row seat in building AI-powered platforms, an AI-first way of working, and high visibility to the leadership team as we grow internationally.

Tasks

  • Feature conceptualization. Turn evidence into product ideas. You will run the full loop, from insight, to concept and options, to a sprint-ready story, and back to the data to see whether it worked.
  • Requirements engineering. Turn customer insights and support feedback into clear, buildable user stories with business context, acceptance criteria and edge cases. Own the qualification funnel so nothing rots and no ticket enters a sprint under-specified.
  • Sprint operations. Run backlog hygiene, standup and review mechanics, dependency flags and blocker tracking with our development team, so decisions get made once and stay made.
  • UAT, QA and testing. Own regression and release testing. Reproduce defects properly, keep the bug board honest, and support UAT and end-to-end dry runs.
  • Analytics and performance measurement. Own recurring KPI reporting across our tool stack, close measurement gaps, and turn funnel and cohort data into insight the team acts on. Every feature we ship is measured against the question: did it work? What was the impact?

Requirements

  • A relevant degree in business engineering, IT, information systems, digital business administration, or a related field, whether ongoing or recently completed.
  • Analytical and creative. You enjoy digging into data to find the real problem, and you are creative about how to solve it. Build-measure-learn is how you already think.
  • Structured and detail oriented. You find clean documentation and reproducible analysis satisfying, not tedious.
  • Comfortable with data. Excel/Sheets at a solid level, able to read dashboards, willing to learn fast
  • Comfortable and confident with software development technicalities, with viewing software code and understanding code with the help of AI
  • Proficient in German (min. B2) and English (C1). You can write a requirement someone else can build from. Your main operating language is English. German

title: Digital Marketing Manager – CRO & SEO (gn), 12-month parental leave cover with an option to extend
description:
Your mission

The Bikeleasing Group is one of the leading companies in employer mobility solutions and company bike leasing. With our brands, we shape modern working environments – and we keep growing.  As Digital Marketing Manager – CRO & SEO (gn), you will take on a key role in driving organic growth and ensuring that our brands Bikeleasing and Probonio are visible and effective in search engines, on our website, and among relevant target audiences. You will work closely with Sales, Product, Data, and Automation, bringing your expertise in SEO, GEO, CRO, and content strategy to the table. If you enjoy taking ownership, working in a data-driven way, and making things happen in a professional environment with short decision-making paths – you’re in the right place. Sounds good? We’d love to meet you. 

  • You maintain and develop key website pages – from product and landing pages to use-case pages – and continuously improve them based on performance signals such as conversion paths, search intent, and content gaps
  • You design and run A/B tests to experimentally improve website performance, focusing on page structure, messaging, CTA logic, internal linking, and friction reduction
  • You build topic and intent clusters for Bikeleasing and Probonio, create and optimise organic content formats (guides, glossary pages, comparison content), and ensure a solid on-page foundation that supports both SEO and GEO
  • You develop and manage an integrated content strategy – including a topic backlog, intent logic (Awareness → Consideration → Conversion), content standards, and success criteria – making output and impact scalable
  • You conceptualise lead assets such as whitepapers and webinars, coordinate their production, and ensure consistent content repurposing into website modules, organic formats, and sales enablement materials


Your profile

  • You have a strong track record of at least 5 years in experimentally driving website performance improvements through A/B testing, and can demonstrate success with relevant KPIs.
  • You bring at least 5 years of experience in organic search optimisation (SEO + GEO) and know how to create sustainable, measurable online visibility.
  • You derive content strategies in a data-driven, SEO- and GEO-informed way – from target audience analysis to topicprioritisation
  • You communicate confidently in German (C2) and English (C1) and can present complex content clearly and in a target-audience-appropriate way
  • Hands-on experience in Paid Search or Paid Social is a plus – not a must, but helpful for close collaboration
